Messages.Author: Omelet
Messages.Body:
I couldn't find anything with a search, so I thought I would pose this question here.

Eldritch Glimmer (1 Blood Cost)

tha - Strike: 2R damage, and this vampire can burn X blood to get +X (ranged) damage. Not usable on the first round of combat.
THA - As above, but for 4R + X ranged damage

Dragos

Dragos does not have to burn blood to pay the cost of combat cards he plays.

---

I just want to confirm whether or not Dragos would need to pay to Burn X Blood for the additional damage.

I suspect that the card cost (1 blood) would be free, but he would need to burn blood to activate the additional damage.

Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Correct answers here.
"Burn blood" is not a cost but an effect, on these cards (Eldricht Glimmer, Chiroptean Marauder, ...), so Dragos can't skip it.

Dragos can play Hidden Strength for 10 without burning any blood - as long as Hidden Strength is playable (== as long as there is at least 1 damage to prevent).
